acceptanceCriteria: The constant is renamed to say it is a wire-format version, or replaced by the per-host adapter version with the reader accepting both, with a test.
body: Found by the 2026-09-27 adapter audit for rc.2. cmd/corvint/host_adapter.go:28 adapterVersion = "0.1.0" is written into local completion events and checked at cmd/corvint/local_completion_event.go:124, while the shipped Claude and Codex adapters are 0.1.4 and 0.2.3. Decide whether it is a wire-format version (rename it) or an adapter version (derive it per host).
